facts.summary: Phase 3 monotherapy trial missed primary endpoint, placebo response high · Phase 3 · REL-1017 in major depressive disorder · not yet approved

evidence.summary: its RELIANCE III study (REL-1017-303), evaluating REL-1017 in the monotherapy setting for Major Depressive Disorder (MDD), did not achieve its primary endpoint
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: did not achieve its primary endpoint, which was a statistically significant improvement in depression symptoms compared to placebo
evidence.safety: REL-1017, which was administered for 28 days to 232 subjects in RELIANCE III, demonstrated very favorable tolerability and safety
evidence.program_discontinued: Relmada continues to enroll patients in RELIANCE I and RELIANCE II, two ongoing Phase 3, placebo-controlled, pivotal studies
